customers.name: Marcus Chen
customers.environment: Windows 11, Nimbus Sync desktop v4.2 + mobile app, connects through a corporate Cisco AnyConnect VPN

history.subject: Files stuck syncing over VPN
history.customer_message: My project files have been stuck on 'syncing' for over an hour. I'm on our office VPN if that matters.
history.agent_reply: Thanks for flagging this, Marcus. Corporate VPNs sometimes throttle the long-lived connection Nimbus Sync uses. I've restarted the sync session on our end — can you confirm it's moving again? If this happens again, try toggling the VPN off and on once, which usually clears it.
history.resolution_summary: VPN was throttling the sync connection; restarted the session server-side and it resumed.

history.subject: Same syncing issue as before
history.customer_message: It's happening again — the same stuck-syncing thing over VPN. I already restarted my router before opening this ticket, so please don't ask me to do that again, it never helps.
history.agent_reply: Understood, and noted — router restarts aren't the fix here, so I won't suggest that again. This looks like the same VPN keep-alive timeout as last time. I've bumped your account's sync keep-alive interval, which should stop this from recurring as often. Let me know if it still stalls.
history.resolution_summary: Same VPN keep-alive timeout as ticket tick_marcus_1; increased the account's sync keep-alive interval. Marcus explicitly asked not to be told to restart his router — that is not an effective fix for him and should not be suggested again.

history.subject: Mobile app not showing latest files
history.customer_message: Different issue this time — my phone isn't showing files I synced from my laptop this morning.
history.agent_reply: Good to isolate that it's a different issue. Your mobile app was on v3.9, which had a delta-sync bug — I've pushed a refresh token so it force-updates to v4.1 on next open. That should bring your laptop's files in within a minute or two.
history.resolution_summary: Mobile app was on an outdated build (v3.9) with a delta-sync bug; force-updated to v4.1 via refresh token.

customers.name: Omar Farouk
customers.environment: Windows 10, Nimbus Sync desktop v4.1, laptop switches between office wifi and sleep frequently

history.subject: Sync freezes after closing laptop lid
history.customer_message: Whenever I close my laptop and open it later, the sync icon just spins forever until I quit and reopen the app.
history.agent_reply: Thanks for the detail — this looks like the sync engine not re-establishing its connection cleanly after sleep. I've restarted your sync session and flagged this for the engineering team as it looks like it may not be isolated to your account.
history.resolution_summary: Sync engine fails to re-establish its connection cleanly after the OS suspends/resumes (sleep-wake). Restarted session as a workaround; flagged as possibly systemic.

history.resolution_summary: Second report this week of the sync engine failing to reconnect after OS sleep/resume. Restarted session as a workaround; confirmed as a recurring, systemic pattern, not isolated.

history.subject: Question about seat billing
